sourceTitle: Cousin Lucy at Play By the Author of the Rollo Books
description: "Cousin Lucy at Play" by Jacob Abbott is a children's book written in the mid-19th century. This story centers around the characters Lucy and her brother Royal as they engage in imaginative play and learning activities intended for children recovering from illness.
